title: MalAvi Genomic Resources record
description: A genome, transcriptome or other large sequence record linked to a cyt b lineage: what kind, where deposited, how long, from which host and study. Added to the release on 2026-09-25 (curator meeting of 2026-09-24, point 9); 11 columns.

LINEAGE_NAME.description: MalAvi lineage the record belongs to (its cyt b barcode is this lineage).

ACCESSION.description: INSDC nucleotide, BioProject, SRA/ENA or assembly accession.

DATABASE.description: Where it is deposited (GenBank, ENA, DDBJ, SRA, ...).

LENGTH_BP.description: Length in base pairs when a single sequence.

DESCRIPTION.description: What the record is, in a few words.

REFERENCE_NAME.description: Citation key of the study that produced it.

DOI.description: DOI of that study, if published.

SOURCE.description: Submission id, curated backbone list, or NCBI scan that brought the row in.
